name: Connected Papers
summary: Visual tool for exploring academic papers and finding ones relevant to a field of research.
description: Connected Papers is a visual tool to help researchers and applied scientists find academic papers relevant to their field of work. Its pages render client-side, so only the site's title and meta description were readable; the interactive paper graph itself could not be inspected.
contains: visual tool for finding academic papers relevant to a field of work
